'''Playtest changes (Players Committee)''' lists [[Virtual cards|Virtual]] card images that the [[Players Committee]] published before a set's official release and changed before the set came out. Under the version rules for this wiki (Bill, 12 November 2026), such a pre-release image is a '''Playtest''' version: it gets its own article titled "(Playtest)" and is listed in the card's Versions box, but it is not the card's original printing. The original printing is the image that was current when the set was officially released.

The images come from the PC's own card image set in its [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable Holotable repository] (<code>Images-HT</code>), where every change to a card image is a dated commit. Many PC images are first published days or weeks before a set's release (set previews, or the image upload before release day); only those whose picture changed before release are listed here. For physical playtest pieces from Decipher's design of the game, see [[Playtest cards]].

== Virtual Modern cards changed before release ==
This section covers Virtual Set 11 and Virtual Sets 25–27 (research of 12 November 2026); other sets may add rows. For Virtual Set 11 the PC uploaded its card images on 1 August 2019 and re-rendered them all on release day (2 August 2019, Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”), so every Set 11 card whose image changed that day has a Playtest version; most changed only in rendering.
